name.description: Extension name; also the store listing title

description.message: Mark paragraphs of GitHub issues and pull requests with a check or a cross and attach private notes as you read.
description.description: Extension summary; also the store listing summary (max 132 characters)

unmarkCheck.description: ✓ mark beside a paragraph (click to remove)

unmarkCross.description: × mark beside a paragraph (click to remove)

editNote.description: Tooltip of a note shown inside the issue body

notePlaceholder.message: A note about this passage (only visible to you)

close.description: Close button of the reply composer

optNote.description: Reply composer: which passages to quote

optCross.description: Reply composer: which passages to quote

optCheck.description: Reply composer: which passages to quote

composeEmpty.message: Nothing to quote yet. Add notes or × marks from the toolbar and they will be collected here as quotes.

quotedCount.description: Reply composer: number of quoted passages

insertCopiedInstead.message: No comment box was found, so the text was copied to the clipboard instead
insertCopiedInstead.description: Reply composer: comment box missing, copied instead

insertFailed.description: Reply composer: comment box missing and copy failed

clearNothing.message: There are no marks or notes on this page to clear.

clearConfirm.message:
This will clear all $MARKED$ marks (✓ and ×) and $NOTED$ notes on this page.
This cannot be undone. Continue?

menuComposeReply.message: Compose a reply from notes and ×
menuComposeReply.description: Context menu item and popup button

menuClearPage.message: Clear all marks and notes on this page

popupStep1.message: Open an issue or a pull request on GitHub.

popupStep2.message: Hover over a paragraph in the description or a comment and a [✓][×][Note] toolbar appears on its left.

popupStep3.message: Marks and notes are saved only in this browser and come back the next time you open the same issue.

popupClear.message: Clear marks and notes on this page

popupNotIssue.message: Open a GitHub issue or the Conversation tab of a pull request first, then try again.
popupNotIssue.description: Popup: pressed outside a supported page

popupFoot.message: The same actions are also available from the right-click menu.

progress.description: Progress badge at the bottom left of the page

progressJump.message: Click to jump to the next unread passage (one without ✓ or ×)

cmdNextUnread.message: Jump to the next unread paragraph

cmdWriteNote.message: Write a note on the selected paragraph

popupOverview.description: Popup: button that opens the saved-pages list

popupShortcuts.description: Popup: heading of the shortcut list

popupShortcutsEdit.description: Popup: link to the shortcut settings

overviewIntro.message: Issues and pull requests you have marked or annotated. The data is stored only in this browser.

overviewCount.description: Saved pages: number of pages shown

overviewEmpty.message: No pages with marks or notes yet.

overviewCounts.description: Saved pages: mark and note counts

overviewProgress.description: Saved pages: progress, relative to the paragraph count at the last save

overviewUnknownDate.description: Saved pages: unknown date (old data format)

overviewDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the marks and notes for "$TITLE$"? This cannot be undone.
overviewDeleteConfirm.description: Saved pages: confirm deleting one page

overviewDeleteStale.message: Delete pages not updated for 90+ days
overviewDeleteStale.description: Saved pages: delete stale pages button

overviewStaleNone.message: No pages have gone 90 days without an update.

overviewStaleConfirm.message: Delete the marks and notes of every page not updated for 90+ days ($COUNT$)? This cannot be undone.
overviewStaleConfirm.description: Saved pages: confirm deleting stale pages

importInvalid.message: Nothing could be imported. Choose a JSON file exported by this extension.

importConfirm.message: Import data for these pages ($COUNT$)? Pages you already have are merged paragraph by paragraph; where both have the same paragraph, the more recently updated page wins.
